effects: Pulls exactly `assets` WHYPE from the signer into the vault with transferFrom, using an approval the signer gave earlier (VaultV2.enter: safeTransferFrom(asset, msg.sender, address(this), assets)).
Mints vault shares (mcHYPE) to `onBehalf`, not necessarily the signer. The number is previewDeposit(assets), set by the vault's share price (VaultV2.deposit / createShares).

Before that, accrueInterest may mint fee shares to the fee recipients, which moves the share price. The vault may then send the deposited WHYPE on to its liquidity adapter. Neither moves any more of the signer's assets.
formats.shown: Deposit the WHYPE amount into the vault. Shares are mcHYPE and go to the onBehalf address. The interpolated intent reads "Deposit X WHYPE for <onBehalf>".

findings.title: deposit: the number of mcHYPE shares minted is not shown; the vault computes it from its share price.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol deposit: `uint256 shares = previewDeposit(assets);` reads totalAssets and totalSupply from storage. The descriptor shows only a constant 'Share ticker' = mcHYPE. Case 0: 1e9 mcHYPE minted to 0x...dEaD (signer null).
findings.fix: None possible from calldata. The 'Share ticker' field could be relabelled 'Shares received (mcHYPE)' so it reads as the thing that arrives.

cases.notes: The 1e9 wei of WHYPE leaving the signer is shown as 0.000000001 WHYPE. The shares going to 0x...dEaD (signer null) are shown under 'Send shares to', and the reader saw this.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: Sends exactly `assets` WHYPE from the vault to `receiver` (VaultV2.exit: safeTransfer(asset, receiver, assets)).
Burns previewWithdraw(assets) shares, rounded up, from `onBehalf` (deleteShares). The count depends on the share price.
If the signer is not `onBehalf`, the burned shares are taken out of the share allowance that `onBehalf` gave the signer.
Before the transfer, the vault may pull liquidity back from its liquidity adapter, and accrueInterest may mint fee shares. Neither changes the WHYPE amount the receiver gets.
formats.shown: Withdraw exactly the WHYPE amount to the receiver. The Owner field names whose shares are used.

findings.title: withdraw: the mcHYPE shares burned from the owner are neither named nor counted; the vault prices them.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol withdraw: `uint256 shares = previewWithdraw(assets);` then `deleteShares(onBehalf, shares)`. Case 1: signer out 299.763741674234870314 mcHYPE. The screen has no field for shares.
findings.fix: The amount cannot be shown from calldata. A constant field like deposit's ('Shares burned: mcHYPE') would at least name the asset that leaves.

cases.notes: The 300 WHYPE arriving is shown exactly. The 299.76 mcHYPE burned is not shown, because the vault computes it. The reader guessed that shares leave but did not know how many.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: Burns exactly `shares` mcHYPE from `onBehalf` (VaultV2.exit: deleteShares(onBehalf, shares)).
Sends previewRedeem(shares) WHYPE from the vault to `receiver`. The amount depends on the share price, and the code sets no minimum.
If the signer is not `onBehalf`, `shares` is taken out of the share allowance that `onBehalf` gave the signer.
The vault may pull liquidity back from its adapter, and accrueInterest may mint fee shares first.
formats.shown: Redeem the given number of mcHYPE shares to the receiver, with the owner shown. Nothing says that WHYPE is the asset paid out.

findings.title: redeem: the screen never names WHYPE as the asset paid out, though the descriptor has it as a constant.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol exit: `SafeERC20Lib.safeTransfer(asset, receiver, assets);` where asset = WHYPE. The descriptor redeem fields are only 'Shares to redeem', 'To' and 'Owner', with intent 'Redeem {#.shares} to {#.receiver}'. metadata.constants.underlyingTicker = 'WHYPE' is unused here. Case 2: signer in 2.000000154916372222 WHYPE. The reader was unsure which asset arrives.
findings.fix: Add a constant field, e.g. {"label":"Receive asset","format":"raw","value":"$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"}, or write the intent as 'Redeem {#.shares} for WHYPE to {#.receiver}'.

findings.title: redeem: the amount of WHYPE received comes from the share price, and the code sets no minimum.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol redeem: `uint256 assets = previewRedeem(shares);` reads vault storage and adapter realAssets. Calldata carries no minimum-assets parameter.

cases.notes: The 1.999241693619880321 mcHYPE burned is shown exactly. The 2.000000154916372222 WHYPE received is not shown at all, neither asset nor amount. The reader knew something arrives but not what.

redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver,.worst: redeem: the screen never names WHYPE as the asset paid out, though the descriptor has it as a constant.
